obernants.approximation_semantics: Mathematical relation; finite correspondence evidence only
obernants.assumptions: Successful standard allocations, terminating single-threaded calls
obernants.domain: Declared bounded API inputs, states and finite fixtures
obernants.observation_scope: Exact values, index order, state transitions and named assertions
obernants.operator: For admitted words W,q,r, an output pair (i,d) is excluded if i is outside W, d is not exact byte edit distance, or d>r. A proposed output list omitting any in-radius index, adding an outside index, duplicating an index or breaking ascending index order is excluded. Overlength query paired with Ok is excluded even for an empty tree.

obernants.operator: A returned list identifies distances only for reported indexes; all dictionaries and queries yielding those distances and excluding other indexes beyond r are compatible. Byte renaming by a bijection preserves edit distances. Empty output may mean empty dictionary or a nonempty dictionary with every word farther than r; inversion is nonunique.
